title: Feature-flag eligibility
summary: Classify feedback into a suitable feature-preview cohort.
why: Semantic eligibility can be a fixed choice; experiment assignment itself belongs in deterministic code.

cohort.instructions: Which preview matches the stated need?

state.feedback: I cannot find old orders by product name.
I want a monthly trend report in a spreadsheet.

limitation: Use a stable hash for A/B allocation and permissions for access. Neither Jev nor an LLM should randomly assign production experiment buckets.
